To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a distributed synchronous controller can be generated for each component arithmetic units in a telescopic arithmetic system, and that the distributed synchronous controllers can be integrated into a final distributed synchronous control unit.

the proposed method can generate a distributed synchronous control for dataflow graphs with a telescopic arithmetic units, and the distributed structure of the synchronous control unit maximally preserves concurrency among operations in dataflow graphs.

the proposed method can achieve the following three advantages: (1) a complete preservation of concurrency, (2) a high degree of freedom in scheduling operations, and (3) a high degree in the utilization of the allocated telescopic arithmetic units.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three topics.

a new design methodology to generate distributed synchronous control units for a dataflow graph with a telescopic arithmetic units allocation, and to analyze the performance improvement effects at a system level.
a distributed synchronous control methodology for dataflow graph-based applications under allocation of telescoping arithmetic units.

the proposed method is an effective and practical solution for designing synchronous control units of dataflow graphs under the allocation of telescopic units.
the proposed method is a practical solution for a design of a distributed synchronous control system for dataflow graphs with telescopic arithmetic units.
the proposed methodology can generate a distributed synchronous control system that maximizes the performance of dataflow graphs under the allocation of telescopic units.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed method is a new design methodology for distributed synchronous control units for a dataflow graph under allocation of telescopes arithmetic units, which is the first of its kind to the best of our knowledge, and it is also an efficient and effective way to generate distributed synchronous control units.
a telescopic arithmetic units can be used as a component unit for a dataflow graph without any performance loss, while the performance of the dataflow graph can be significantly improved.

the distributed synchronous control units for telescopic arithmetic units are the most suitable synchronous control units for the telescopic arithmetic units among the existing synchronous control unit designs for variable computation time arithmetic unit.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the distributed structure of the synchronous control unit can be automatically generated from the original dataflow graph, and the generated synchronous control unit is guaranteed to be deadlock free.
the proposed design methodology can be applied to a wide range of dataflow graphs, which is demonstrated by applying the methodology to a set of representative dataflow graphs.
the proposed method is a general design methodology for a synchronous controller of a dataflow graph under allocation of a variable computation time arithmetic unit.
